notes.content:
BIG UPDATE ALERT
Sorry for the delay, this was originally meant to release on September 7th. 

This one’s a long time coming
There’s been additional changes to the original ships, along with the addition of 
3 NEW PLANES

But most importantly, we are happy to announce the game’s full support of the XBOX One controller. Now you can take down hordes of enemies from the comfort of your couch. The controls for the game can be accessed in the Options menu for your viewing pleasure. 

Now, 
Get ready to launch into the abyss, as three more planes enter the fray in RADARjAM! 

[b]Splash 2[/b]: 
[img]https://i.imgur.com/15T3qDk.png[/img]
The interceptor with explosive rounds! 
Don’t go too crazy, your maneuverability is going to have to be top notch to survive!
Splash 2 is available in game for $$45,000
[img]https://i.imgur.com/mEwoMjw.gif[/img]

[b]Bandit 3[/b]:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/a6POCS0.png[/img]
The dogfighter with auto-tracking rounds!
When there’s weak enemies, the rounds can go through them with ease. However, watch out for larger ships, as the targeting system still locks onto them!
Bandit 3 is available in game for $$100,000
[img]https://i.imgur.com/RJzmd31.gif[/img]

[b]Starfighter 4[/b]:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/NlHteCq.png[/img]
The plane from the future! 
Engage enemies with your devastating dual laser cannons, and eviscerate their reinforcements with your cluster missiles! 
Starfighter 4 is available in game for $$75,000
[img]https://i.imgur.com/BowzOoc.gif[/img]


There’s also been additional patches with the game:
-Fixed Bulldog Dash anim
-Ace One missiles now swarm properly
-Spade V Bomb now delayed for maximum impact
-New ship select UI to describe guns and ship abilities
-After death the game now transitions to the Game Over screen properly
-Full XBOX One controller support
-A PAUSE FUNCTION
-and MANY more

Update 1.20 has been the biggest update since launch, however it’s not done yet. In the coming weeks we are launching Online Leaderboards through Steam Leaderboards in update 1.25. Please follow us on Twitter @HamraDigital to get all updates on RADARjAM and our other projects.

Thank you so much for following the development of RADARjAM!
